en: to wash; to do the laundry

examples.ko: 주말에 모아 둔 옷을 한꺼번에 세탁해요.
examples.en: On weekends I wash all the clothes I've saved up at once.
This garment shrinks if you wash it in water.
Yesterday I washed the big blanket at home.
Be sure to check the pockets before doing the laundry.

examples.ko: 비가 많이 와서 세탁할 수가 없어요.
examples.en: It's raining a lot, so I can't do laundry.

examples.ko: 세탁해서 말린 수건에서 좋은 냄새가 나요.
examples.en: The towels I washed and dried smell nice.

explain: 집에서 빨래할 때는 '빨래하다'를 더 많이 쓰고, 세탁하다는 조금 격식 있는 말이에요. '세탁소'에 맡기는 드라이클리닝은 '세탁'이라고 해요. '세탁기', '세탁물'처럼 다른 말에 붙여서도 자주 써요.

phrases.en: I do the laundry at home every weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 집에서 옷을 빨 때는 '세탁하다'보다 더 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: More natural than 세탁하다 for washing clothes at home.

phrases.en: I put the clothes in the washing machine and pressed the button.
phrases.nuance_en: Built from 세탁, it means the washing machine.

phrases.en: I left this coat at the dry cleaner's.
phrases.nuance_ko: 집에서 빨기 어려운 옷을 맡길 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for clothes that are hard to wash at home.

explain_en: At home Koreans usually say 빨래하다; 세탁하다 is a little more formal. Dropping clothes at a cleaner (세탁소) is also called 세탁. It combines in words like 세탁기 (washing machine) and 세탁물 (laundry).

dis.h: launder clothes; formal, machine or service

p.n: The replacement is casual and suggests washing by hand.

examples.en: We decided to go to Jeju Island for this weekend trip.
I took a weekend trip to the nearby sea with friends.
I'm packing my bags to get ready for the weekend trip.
If the weather is nice, shall we go to the mountains for a weekend trip?
Last weekend's trip was so enjoyable.
I'll show you the photos I took on the weekend trip.

explain: 주말에 다녀오는 짧은 여행이에요. '주말여행을 가다/다녀오다'처럼 써요. 하루만 다녀오면 '당일치기', 하룻밤 자면 '1박 2일'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: My family and I decided to go on a weekend trip.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 갈 여행을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it for a trip you are about to take.
phrases.en_equiv: to go on a weekend trip

phrases.en: I went on a weekend trip and it was really fun.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 갔다 온 여행을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it for a trip you have already returned from.
phrases.en_equiv: to come back from a weekend trip

phrases.en: Let's make our weekend trip plans together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여행 전에 일정을 정할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when planning before the trip.

explain_en: It's a short trip taken over the weekend. Say '주말여행을 가다' or '다녀오다'. A one-day trip is '당일치기', and one with an overnight stay is '1박 2일'.

examples.en: My younger sibling is doing a puzzle on the living room floor.
This puzzle was so hard that I gave up.

examples.ko: 주말마다 가족과 함께 퍼즐 게임을 해요.
examples.en: Every weekend I play puzzle games with my family.

examples.ko: 친구가 생일 선물로 천 조각 퍼즐을 줬어요.
examples.en: My friend gave me a thousand-piece puzzle as a birthday present.

examples.ko: 저는 어려운 문제를 푸는 퍼즐이 제일 재미있어요.
examples.en: I find puzzles where you solve tough problems the most fun.

examples.ko: 조각 하나가 없어져서 퍼즐이 완성되지 않았어요.
examples.en: One piece went missing, so the puzzle wasn't completed.

explain: 퍼즐은 조각을 맞추는 직소 퍼즐뿐 아니라 낱말 퍼즐 같은 놀이도 말해요. 조각은 '퍼즐을 맞추다', 문제나 수수께끼는 '퍼즐을 풀다'와 잘 어울려요.

phrases.en: I put a puzzle together with my family.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조각을 제자리에 끼우는 퍼즐에 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The usual pairing for jigsaw-type puzzles with pieces to fit.

phrases.en: If you solve this puzzle, I'll give you a gift.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문제나 수수께끼 같은 퍼즐의 답을 찾을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for finding the answer to a riddle-type puzzle.

phrases.en: I do word puzzles when I'm bored.
phrases.nuance_en: A game where you fill letters into squares.

explain_en: 퍼즐 covers jigsaw puzzles and also word puzzles and similar games. Pieces go with 퍼즐을 맞추다 (fit), while problems and riddles go with 퍼즐을 풀다 (solve).
